headline: Oil Prices Fall Over 7 Percent on Hopes for US-Iran Talks
summary: Oil prices dropped more than 7 percent as diplomatic efforts between Washington and Tehran eased fears of potential disruptions to Middle Eastern supplies.
why: Geopolitical developments involving major oil-producing regions directly impact global crude benchmarks, influencing energy sector equities and broader macroeconomic inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Diplomatic easing of Middle Eastern supply concerns directly removes risk premium from crude oil futures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lower perceived risk of supply disruptions led to an immediate liquidation of oil risk premiums, causing a sharp drop of over 7 percent.
